title: Wrisst Dialog Scene
description: Array of dialog nodes for the Wrisst dialog system.

NodeId.description: The 'id' of another node to jump to.

FlagType.description: Which GameState bucket the flag is stored in.

AbilityType.description: Stat used for the ability check roll.

SetFlag.description: Flag name(s) to set when this node is processed.

ClearFlag.description: Flag name(s) to clear when this node is processed.

BonusIfEntry.description: A conditional bonus applied to an ability check roll.

has_flag.description: Bonus applies if this flag is set.

has_item.description: Bonus applies if player has this item (Items/…tres).

has_any_flag.description: Bonus applies if any of these flags are set.

ConditionObject.description: Visibility or gating condition for show_if / hide_if.

has_flag.description: True if ALL listed flags are set. Accepts a single flag name or an array.

has_item.description: True if player owns ALL listed items. Accepts a single item path or an array.

has_any_flag.description: True if any of these flags are set.

has_any_item.description: True if player owns any of these items.

has_item_count.description: True if player owns a certain quantity of an item.

ability_tier.description: True if the specified ability is in the given tier.

min_reputation.description: True if reputation with an NPC meets a minimum.

min_horny.description: True if horny level with an NPC meets a minimum.

min_species_stat.description: True if a species stat meets a minimum.

content_disabled.description: True if this content category is disabled in settings. Known values: 'feral', 'violence', 'monsterfolk'.

all_of.description: All sub-conditions must be true (AND logic).

any_of.description: At least one sub-condition must be true (OR logic).

ConditionValue.description: A condition for show_if. Either an object or a shorthand string.

HideIfValue.description: A condition for hide_if. Use 'picked' to auto-hide after first selection.

dc.description: Difficulty class — the roll must meet or beat this.

ChoiceOption.description: One option in a choice node's 'options' array.

text.description: Displayed option text. Convention: start with '> '.

next.description: Node to jump to (simple, no check).

bonus_if.description: Conditional bonuses applied to the check.

show_if.description: Option is only shown if this condition is true.

hide_if.description: Option is hidden if this condition is true. Use 'picked' to permanently hide after first selection.

CommonNodeProps.description: Properties shared by all node types.

id.description: Unique node identifier within this file.

next.description: Default next node after this one.

clear.description: If true, clears dialog UI before this node displays.

end.description: If true, emits dialog_ended signal after this node.

NarrationNode.description: type:narration — Displays prose/narrative text. No speaker name.

text.description: Narrative prose. Supports BBCode ([b], [i], [p]) and inline commands ([@COMMAND]).

NpcNode.description: type:npc — NPC dialogue with a speaker name and portrait.

name.description: NPC display name (matches portrait ID in character_map).

text.description: Spoken dialogue. Supports BBCode and inline commands ([@COMMAND]).

ChoiceNode.description: type:choice — Presents the player with a list of selectable options.

options.description: List of player options. Each option is a ChoiceOption.

CommandNode.description: type:command — Executes one or more @COMMAND directives with no displayed text.

name.description: Optional label (used by some commands for context).

CheckNode.description: type:check — Auto-rolls an ability check when reached. No player interaction.

LogicNode.description: type:logic — Conditional branching without display. Has sub-types via logic_type.

LogicCheckFlags.description: Logic subtype: checks whether ALL listed flags are set.

flags.description: All of these flags must be set for success.

LogicCondition.description: Logic subtype: checks a stat, item, or currency condition.

deduct.description: If true, currency is deducted when check passes.

oneOf.description:
Shorthand string condition. Supports:
  HAS_ITEM <Items/path.tres>
  HAS_REPUTATION <npc_id> <amount>
  HAS_SPECIES_STAT <species_id> <stat_key> <amount>

if_true.description: Alternative to on_success for string-based conditions.

if_false.description: Alternative to on_fail for string-based conditions.

LogicSceneFrom.description: Logic subtype: branches based on which scene the player arrived from (GameState.last_scene_id). NOTE: the dispatch for this node type ('check_scene_from_multi') is currently commented out in dialog_flow_manager.gd — this will not fire until re-enabled.

check_scene_from.description: Maps scene_id strings to next node IDs. Use 'default' as a fallback.

CheckTempFlagsMultiNode.description: type:check_temp_flags_multi — Routes to a node based on which temp flag is set. First match wins.

check_temp_flags.description: Map of flag_name → node_id. Add a 'default' key as fallback.

DialogNode.description: Any valid dialog node. Determined by the 'type' field.
